column1: 大灭|World Ender|增加生命并暂时升空，强化吸血和被动循环；击杀刷新形态时间与加速。结束时生命截回基础上限。|Gain health and temporarily fly, with stronger life steal and passive strikes. Kills refresh the form and speed boost. Health above the base maximum is removed when it ends.

冰雪风暴|Glacial Storm|在身前创造风暴，落地伤害后周期造成伤害与减速。施法锁定移动、攻击和朝向；已落地风暴独立存在。|Create a storm ahead that deals impact damage followed by periodic damage and slows. Casting locks movement, attacks and facing; a landed storm persists independently.
海克斯穿透激光|Hextech Piercing Laser|沿朝向发射穿透激光，伤害路径上的地面敌人。|Fire a piercing laser forward, damaging ground enemies along its path.
万箭齐发|Volley|向前方扇形发射箭矢，每箭在首个敌人处消失；同次施法对同一目标不重复伤害，并触发冰霜减速。|Fire a fan of arrows that stop at the first enemy. A target takes damage only once per cast and receives the frost slow.

星落/天瀑|Falling Star / The Skies Descend|击杀充能，向前方降星造成伤害与眩晕；满层强化伤害和眩晕，并产生全场扩散冲击波。|Kills build charges. Drop a star ahead for damage and a stun; full charges empower both and add an arena-wide expanding shockwave.
沙兵现身|Arise!|在自身四周召唤黄沙士兵。|Summon Sand Soldiers around the caster.
虚空激流|Void Surge|向前突进，对路径上空地敌军及建筑造成一次伤害。|Dash forward and damage each enemy ground unit, air unit or structure on the path once.
火箭轰击|Missile Barrage|导弹碰到首个敌人后爆炸；最后一发为强化导弹。未命中则在射程尽头消失。|The missile explodes on first enemy contact. The final missile is empowered; missed missiles vanish at maximum range.
强化腐蚀|Empowered Corrosion|敌方进入腐蚀区域立即受到移动减速，离开后迅速消退。|Enemies are slowed immediately on entering Corrosion; the slow fades quickly after leaving.

诺克萨斯断头台|Noxian Guillotine|强化下一击，按目标流血层数增伤；血怒进一步强化。技能不受致盲影响，击杀赠送免费追斩。|Empower the next strike, scaling with the target’s bleed stacks and Noxian Might. Unaffected by blind; a kill grants a free follow-up.
烈性火药|Volatile Powder|提高爆炸伤害，不改变范围或击退。|Increase explosion damage without changing the area or knockback.
强化冰冻|Empowered Freeze|施放时另建更大的减速区域，降低移动与攻击速度；减速区域比冻结持续更久，不扩大冻结本身。|Create a larger slowing zone on cast, reducing movement and attack speed. It outlasts the freeze but does not expand the frozen area.
致命打击|Decisive Strike|强化下一次普攻并刷新攻击前摇，尚未打出时加速移动。|Empower the next basic attack and restart its wind-up, gaining movement speed until it is delivered.
审判|Judgment|旋转并周期伤害周围地面敌人。期间不能普攻，但仍可移动和转向。|Spin to periodically damage nearby ground enemies. Basic attacks are locked, but movement and turning remain possible.
怒气爆发|Rage Burst|向前重击并眩晕地面敌人；小纳尔先变为大纳尔。|Slam forward to damage and stun ground enemies. Mini Gnar transforms first.

快刀乱剪|Snip Snip!|普攻命中积攒剪切次数。每剪附带被动，中央提高基础伤害；满层首次实际命中回血，空放不回血。|Basic-attack hits add snips. Each snip applies the passive, with higher base damage in the center. At full charge, the first actual hit heals; a miss does not.

丝缕缠流|Hallowed Mist|创建固定圣霭，阻止圈外敌人选取格温或施加新效果；已有状态继续生效，格温离开则结界消失。|Create fixed mist that prevents outside enemies from targeting Gwen or applying new effects. Existing effects continue; leaving the area removes the mist.
强化治疗|Empowered Heal|治疗全场友方普通单位，落点范围内治疗量进一步提高，不提供护盾。|Heal allied non-structure units across the arena, with increased healing near the chosen point. Grants no shield.
过量治疗|Overheal|提高范围治疗量，部分溢出治疗转为限时护盾。|Increase area healing and convert part of excess healing into a temporary shield.
男爵之力|Hand of Baron|强化本次部署的存活成员；不同兵种分别获得各自的伤害、速度或护盾加成。|Empower surviving members of this deployment. Each minion type receives its own damage, speed or shield bonuses.

反击风暴|Counter Strike|暂时免疫普攻伤害，仍可移动攻击；结束时伤害并眩晕周围地面敌人，闪避的攻击提高伤害。死亡取消，凝滞到期不补发。|Temporarily ignore basic-attack damage while still moving and attacking. Then damage and stun nearby ground enemies, scaling with attacks avoided. Death cancels it; expiry in stasis does not defer the burst.

枪炮交响曲！|Switcheroo!|切换武器并重置旧普攻后摇，切换期间不能攻击；机枪命中叠攻速，换武器清空层数。|Switch weapons and reset the old attack recovery. Attacks are locked during the switch. Minigun hits stack attack speed; switching clears those stacks.

虚空行走|Riftwalk|向前传送并伤害落点附近敌人。连续使用提高费用和伤害，达到上限后不再增加；建筑阻挡会调整落点。|Blink forward and damage nearby enemies on arrival. Repeated casts increase cost and damage up to a cap. Structures force the landing point to adjust.
星界恩典|Celestial Blessing|回复自身生命并短暂加速。|Restore health and briefly increase movement speed.
巨镰横扫|Reaping Slash|向前突进后旋转，分段伤害地面敌人。拉亚斯特附加最大生命伤害，并在每段命中时回复生命。|Dash forward, then spin, damaging ground enemies in separate stages. Rhaast adds max-health damage and heals on a hit in each stage.
递增电击|Escalating Lightning|逐段提高电击伤害；某段无目标不会改变后续段的伤害档位。|Increase damage with each strike. A strike with no target does not change later damage tiers.

狂野生长|Wild Growth|选择范围内费用最高、同费最近的未增益友军，永久增加生命和体型并击退周围敌军。不能重复增益；无目标则退还消耗。|Permanently increase health and size for the highest-cost eligible ally in range, preferring the nearest on ties, and knock back nearby enemies. Cannot stack; no valid target refunds the cast.
大地震颤|Ground Slam|伤害周围地面敌人，同时降低移动和攻击速度。|Damage nearby ground enemies and reduce their movement and attack speed.

冥府之握|Nether Grasp|下一击命中后引导眩晕，自身不能移动或攻击。控制可打断引导，但已建立的持续伤害区域独立存在。|The next hit begins a stunning channel that locks the caster’s movement and attacks. Control can interrupt the channel, but the established damage zone persists independently.
虚空虫群|Void Swarm|施法期间停止普攻，开启裂隙依次召唤虚灵。|Pause basic attacks while casting, opening a rift that summons Voidlings in sequence.
高原血统|Highlander|提高移动与攻击速度，并免疫移速和攻速减速。|Increase movement and attack speed while ignoring slows to either.
大步流星|Strut|短暂提高移动速度与攻击速度。|Temporarily increase movement and attack speed.

黑暗庇护|Shroud of Darkness|抵挡一次完整敌方攻击、法术或技能及其附带效果，成功后加攻速。已有状态和友方效果不受影响。|Block one complete enemy attack, spell or ability and its attached effects, then gain attack speed. Existing statuses and allied effects remain unaffected.
暗影之刃|Umbra Blades|强化下一次普攻，追加周围范围伤害并按实际生命伤害回血；不能叠加储存。|Empower the next basic attack with nearby area damage and healing based on actual health damage. Cannot store multiple charges.

残暴打击|Vicious Strikes|本批存活狂战士获得限时护盾、攻速和普攻吸血。护盾耗尽不会提前结束其他增益。|Grant surviving Olafs in the group a temporary shield, attack speed and basic-attack life steal. Losing the shield does not end the other buffs.

熔铸冲锋|Searing Charge|蓄力后向前冲锋，路径伤害较低；撞上建筑、河流或边界才触发范围伤害与眩晕。|Charge forward after a wind-up, dealing minor path damage. Only collision with a structure, river or arena edge triggers area damage and a stun.
贯星长枪|Comet Spear|向前刺击地面敌人，满红怒时消耗全部层数提高伤害；未满时保留并增加红怒。|Thrust into ground enemies ahead. Full Mortal Will is consumed for higher damage; otherwise retain and add a stack.

仙灵汲取|Faerie Siphon|本批存活皮克斯的后续普攻按实际生命伤害回血，可暂时超过基础生命上限；护盾伤害与过量伤害不计入。|Surviving Pix in this group heal from actual health damage dealt by subsequent basic attacks, up to an increased health cap. Shield damage and overkill do not count.
旋转重拳|Sweeping Strike|伤害前方半圆的地面敌军及建筑，冲撞的准备、冲刺与收势期间不可用。|Damage ground enemies and structures in a forward semicircle. Unavailable during charge preparation, movement and recovery.

黄沙庇护|Sand Aegis|为本次部署成员提供护盾，到期时逐人判断，盾未破则回满生命。召唤士兵不自动获得主动资格。|Shield deployment members; on expiry, each member with an intact shield heals to full. Summoned soldiers do not automatically gain active eligibility.
谦卑|Humility|降低周围敌人的移动与攻击速度。|Reduce nearby enemies’ movement and attack speed.
蓄意轰拳|Haymaker|锁定行动后向前轰出梯形冲击波，豪意提高伤害，中心伤害更高；消耗的豪意同时提供衰减护盾。|Lock actions to release a trapezoid blast. Grit increases damage, with extra damage in the center, and provides a decaying shield.
灵魂熔炉|Soul Furnace|获得护盾，计时结束时若护盾未破，移除剩余护盾并对周围空地单位及建筑造成伤害。|Gain a shield. If it survives until expiry, remove it and damage nearby ground units, air units and structures.
友军优待|Friendly Favor|缩短友军凝滞时间，敌方时长不变。|Shorten allied stasis without changing enemy duration.
日耀庇护|Solar Aegis|为攻击范围内所有存活友方单位和建筑提供限时护盾，包括防御塔和水晶。|Grant a temporary shield to living allies within attack range, including buildings, towers and the Nexus.
余震|Aftershock|暂时减伤，到期后向周围爆炸；死亡取消，凝滞中到期不爆炸。|Temporarily reduce damage, then explode nearby. Death cancels the explosion; expiry during stasis prevents it.

致盲|Blinding Dart|下一次出手改为技能吹箭，使目标后续普攻无法造成伤害。该吹箭自身不受致盲影响，也不消耗致盲次数。|Replace the next strike with an ability dart that prevents damage from subsequent basic attacks. The dart ignores blind and does not consume blind charges.
亡者集结|Gather the Fallen|立即召唤额外的雾行者。|Summon additional Mist Walkers.
急速射击|Rapid Fire|暂时提高攻击速度，缩短攻击间隔。|Temporarily increase attack speed and shorten the attack interval.

无尽怒火|Undying Rage|立即满怒并暂时拒绝死亡，暴击不消耗怒气。除凝滞外可在控制中使用，不解除控制，也不治疗。|Fill Fury and temporarily prevent death; critical hits do not consume Fury. Usable under control except stasis, but does not cleanse control or heal.
万能牌|Wild Cards|向前方发射穿透牌，命中空地敌军；同次施法对同一敌人只造成一次伤害。|Fire piercing cards ahead at ground and air enemies. Each enemy takes damage only once per cast.
火力全开|Spray and Pray|提高攻速、弹速与射程，普攻改为固定方向的穿透弩箭，不再追踪移动目标。|Increase attack speed, projectile speed and range. Attacks become straight piercing bolts that no longer track moving targets.
虚空迸发|Void Burst|立即摧毁传送门并召唤虚空兽。|Immediately destroy the portal and summon Voidspawn.
归于虚空|Return to the Void|立即死亡并留下治疗区，不给敌方金币赏金。|Die immediately and leave the healing zone, without granting enemy bounty gold.
虚空强化|Void Empowerment|永久提高本批成员的伤害、生命、体型和移动速度。|Permanently increase this group’s damage, health, size and movement speed.

虚空献祭|Void Sacrifice|区域持续期间，双方符合条件的非建筑单位真正死亡时生成己方近战虚空鱼；近战虚空鱼不参与转化。|During the zone’s lifetime, eligible non-structure units from either team create allied melee remora on actual death. Melee remora are excluded.

虚空再生|Void Regeneration|限时标记本批存活成员，期间被击杀则原地生成新鱼；新鱼不继承再生或主动资格。|Temporarily mark surviving members. A marked unit killed during the effect is replaced at its death position. Replacements inherit neither regeneration nor active eligibility.
新月护卫|Crescent Guard|挥舞长枪伤害并击退周围敌人，施放期间锁定移动、攻击和朝向。|Sweep the spear to damage and knock back nearby enemies, locking movement, attacks and facing while casting.
临终仪式|Last Rites|强化下一次范围攻击，命中时固定回复生命，每次攻击只治疗一次。|Empower the next area attack and restore a fixed amount of health on hit, only once per attack.
多重电击|Multi-Zap|在相同位置追加一次电击，重复伤害与眩晕。|Add another strike at the same position, repeating its damage and stun.
blitzcrank:能量铁拳|Power Fist|刷新普攻，下一次攻击造成1.5倍伤害并眩晕敌方单位1秒。|Reset the attack and empower the next hit to deal 1.5 times damage and stun an enemy unit for 1 second.

ekko:时空断裂|Chronobreak|开始回溯时回复满血，不可选中回溯0.75秒，回到施法时4秒前的位置并对半径140内敌人造成300伤害。历史不足时使用最早位置。|Restore full health at cast start, become untargetable for 0.75 seconds, then return to the position from 4 seconds before casting and deal 300 damage within 140 units. Use the earliest recorded position if history is shorter.

hecarim:恐惧之灵|Spirit of Dread|起手0.44秒期间锁攻击，随后开启4秒领域，每0.5秒对周围地面敌人造成20伤害。领域伤害和普通攻击按实际生命伤害的30%治疗自身；期间可以移动和攻击。|After a 0.44-second wind-up that locks attacks, create a 4-second field dealing 20 damage to nearby ground enemies every 0.5 seconds. Field damage and basic attacks heal for 30% of actual health damage. Movement and attacks remain available during the field.

jayce:超能电荷 / 闪电领域|Hyper Charge / Lightning Field|炮形态：4秒内接下来3次普攻获得3倍攻速，次数用完或时间到期即结束。锤形态：开启4秒电场，每0.5秒对周围敌军造成10伤害。两种效果换形后均保留。|Cannon: the next 3 attacks within 4 seconds gain triple attack speed. Hammer: create a 4-second field dealing 10 damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds. Both effects persist through form changes.

powder_keg:烈性火药|Volatile Powder|立即引爆。爆炸造成生命伤害后，生命低于15%的敌方单位被斩杀；不斩杀建筑，无法突破拒绝死亡。|Detonate immediately. After the explosion deals health damage, execute enemy units below 15% health. Cannot execute structures or bypass death prevention.

samira:炼狱扳机|Inferno Trigger|消耗悍勇本色全部5层，旋转射击2秒并沿释放时记住的朝向持续移动，每秒对半径180内的地面与空中敌军造成120伤害；期间不能普攻或叠加被动层数。每次1金币，冷却5秒，次数不限。|Consume all 5 Style stacks to fire for 2 seconds while moving along the direction fixed at cast start. Deal 120 damage per second to ground and air enemies within 180 units. Cannot attack or gain Style while casting. Costs 1 gold, has a 5-second cooldown and unlimited uses.
tidal_wave:踏浪而行|Surging Tides|浪潮经过己方地面单位时，给予2秒30%移速加成；每次浪潮对每个单位只生效一次，不作用于建筑。|The wave grants allied ground units 30% movement speed for 2 seconds, once per unit per wave. Does not affect buildings.

xin:无畏冲锋|Audacious Charge|下一次攻击距离提升至4格，突进至目标身前，对目标周围70像素内地面敌人造成一次普攻伤害，不受致盲影响；命中后攻击速度提高40%，持续5秒。|The next attack gains a 4-tile range and dashes to the target, dealing basic-attack damage to ground enemies within 70 units of it. Ignores blind. On hit, gain 40% attack speed for 5 seconds.
